image_description: A black wrought-iron bannister system installed on an outdoor staircase. The railing features a continuous top handrail and vertical balusters with decorative scrollwork (S-curves) at the top and bottom, connected by straight vertical bars. A thicker newel post anchors the corner where the railing turns. The background shows white stucco walls and a glimpse of a roof or upper landing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Vertical railing system following staircase geometry creating diagonal linear pattern.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The railing clearly follows the incline of the stairs in the foreground and the horizontal landing in the background, creating distinct linear patterns.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Continuous handrail supported by evenly spaced balusters.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A continuous black metal rail runs along the top, supported by vertical elements that appear regularly spaced.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Balusters are slender cylindrical or turned posts of narrow diameter, closely spaced relative to their height.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vertical bars are slender metal rods, consistent with the 'slender' description, though they are flat/rectangular rather than cylindrical, which is acceptable for metal balustrades.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Handrail is smooth rounded or molded strip running parallel to staircase incline.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The top rail appears smooth and maintains a consistent distance from the stair nosing, running parallel to the incline.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Newel posts thicker vertical supports anchor ends and corners.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A visibly thicker vertical post is present at the corner turn of the staircase, anchoring the two sections of the railing.
The geometry of the railing matches the slope of the visible steps.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Materials range from polished wood with ornate turnings to sleek metal with minimal design.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The material is clearly dark metal (likely iron or steel) with a semi-gloss finish, fitting the 'sleek metal' description.
Visual texture and thinness of components confirm metal construction.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Evenly spaced vertical posts creating rhythmic pattern.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The spacing between the vertical decorative elements is consistent, creating a clear visual rhythm.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom right corner, base of the railing
artifact_observations.reasoning: The bottom of the front-most baluster seems to merge indistinctly with the stair tread or shadow area. It lacks a clear mounting point or base plate, appearing to float slightly or melt into the dark step surface.

The decorative scrollwork on the rear railing section appears slightly flattened and inconsistent in perspective compared to the foreground railing, suggesting minor geometric warping typical of AI generation.
The stucco texture on the wall is overly uniform and lacks fine-grained noise or variation, appearing slightly 'painted' or smoothed out.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bannister/balustrade and not a generic fence or gate.
To verify the 3D spatial relationship between the railing and the stairs, ensuring the railing sits correctly on the steps and doesn't clip through them.
To check for connectivity issues where the thin metal bars meet the handrail and the floor, looking for melting or broken connections.
To assess the realism of the metal reflections and the background wall texture.

focus_areas: Connectivity of baluster bases to stair treads
Consistency of decorative scrollwork perspective across different depths
Physical plausibility of the newel post anchoring
Metal material reflectivity and edge sharpness
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the base of the vertical bars. In AI images, these often fail to connect solidly to the ground plane. Also, check if the decorative curves are symmetrical and physically possible (i.e., not twisting in impossible ways).
